title: A Joomla quickstart provision ends its pairing on the inspect answer a bound site really gives, which carries no `bound` field
steps: S1: On a machine with php (or docker) run from the TCH checkout: node --test packages/fleet/tracy-fleet-operation/test/joomla-contract-bind.test.mjs
S2: Read the pass/fail/skip counts and the two tests named 'REGRESSION #824'.
expect: 0 failures and 0 skipped: the suite runs the real joomla-bootstrap.php against a fake database and door.
A first pairing and a re-run both complete when inspect answers {ok:true, contract:'<requested id>'} with or without `revision`, and with no `bound` key.

The read-back refuses: another, empty, missing or non-string contract; `ok` that is not exactly true; a status outside 2xx or no answer; `bound:false`; `construction:true` (also beside `bound:true`); a `bound` or `construction` that is present but not a boolean.
A bind answer still needs `bound:true` beside the requested contract, or the exact 'This site is already bound to <contract>' conflict.
evidence: Dev, 03/10/2026, reinstalling quickstart/ja-essence/j6: provision failed after a successful bind with `Quickstart contract inspect after bind did not confirm it: {"ok":true,"contract":"ja-essence/j6/1.0.0"}` (issue #824). The suite's door stub had answered inspect with `bound:true`, a field the component's inspect of a bound site does not carry.
fence: tracy_inspect_confirms only; bind acceptance, token handling and the retry bound are unchanged. Not covered: a provision on a live host
